enumeration_note: One pullback-continuation strategy taught bidirectionally (buy in uptrend / sell in downtrend). The long and short sides are directional mirrors of a single Fibonacci-retracement skeleton (50-61.8% pullback in trend direction, TP beyond prior swing, SL beyond originating swing) â€” not opposing logic, so enumerated as one strategy with long/short variants.

coaching_notes: You always need to enter the market in early stages of its trend otherwise you'll end up losing your trade
You can't trade in a non trending market
But if you'll follow each step carefully then the chances of loss are minimal
If you have identified the trend on its early stages then you can end up making huge profits from a single trend, because you just need to repeat the same process again and again
element_inventory: PRECONDITION: only trade when a trend is established â€” identify trend direction on the 4-hour timeframe using a trend line
PRECONDITION: only place buy trades in an uptrend; only place sell trades in a downtrend
BUY entry: draw fib from swing low to recent swing high; enter when price touches between the 50% and 61.8% levels
SELL entry: draw fib from swing high to recent swing low; enter when price touches between the 50% and 61.8% levels
BUY take profit: above the previous swing high
BUY stop loss: below the swing low
SELL take profit: below the previous swing low
SELL stop loss: above the swing high
strategies.entry_summary: Trade only in the direction of the established trend (trend identified on the 4-hour timeframe using a trend line). In an uptrend, draw the Fibonacci retracement from the swing low to the recent swing high and enter a buy when price touches anywhere between the 50% and 61.8% levels. In a downtrend, draw the Fibonacci from the swing high to the recent swing low and enter a sell when price touches anywhere between the 50% and 61.8% levels. Execution on the 1-hour timeframe.
strategies.exit_summary: Buy: take profit above the previous swing high, stop loss below the swing low. Sell: take profit below the previous swing low, stop loss above the swing high.
